files.notes: Original component fixture is translated to the shipped two-action issue reference menu. Callback actions use Open preview; native gestures use a real issue anchor and popup destination. Keyboard, focus restoration, touch geometry, visual focus, Escape propagation, replacement, read-only/no-action state, mobile palette ownership, theme/OS/storage and Settings/session assertions are retained. Current DOM names replace obsolete configurable menu labels. Appearance uses current applyPreferences(savePreferences()) boundary and data-theme/colorScheme rather than retired reactive stores/class names. Preference OS/storage case loads the actual preferences module and production stylesheet on an isolated real-origin document, matching original component isolation; full clear does not accidentally test authenticated navigation. Original disabled-only and empty configurations also run as explicit DOM boundaries on the real two-action menu with unchanged handlers: stay open/inert under ArrowDown/Home/Enter, never invoke callbacks, Escape restores trigger. They are unsupported configurable-menu contracts and not independently reachable product regressions. Settings and isolated preference component capture actual pageerrors.
